description: Static validation: returns diagnostics with severity, stable code, message and 1-based line/column. No "error"-severity diagnostic means the template is structurally sound — read the warnings before rendering, because some of them (plural.locale-missing) mean a block will not resolve. Pass knownVariables for names you will supply at render time to silence their variable.undefined warnings.

knownVariables.description: Variable names the caller will supply at render time (case-insensitive).

locale.description: Locale for {plural …} arity, e.g. "en" (2-form) or "ru" (3-form: ru/uk/be/sr/hr/bs). Omit for the 2-form default.

template.description: Spintax template source. #include is disabled on this server.

name: validate_spintax
title: Validate a spintax template
